zh-CN.Estimate plywood sheets for a bookcase w: 围绕“Bookcase Plywood Sheet Calculator”的实用流程，帮助个人木工和小型工坊在购买板材前看清零件、排版、余料和切割顺序。
zh-CN.A useful bookcase plywood sheet calculat: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.Capture finished width, height, depth, s: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.Use this sequence: size the long sides f: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.The common failure is counting shelf are: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Turn the Layout Into Shop Work: Turn the Layout Into Shop Work
zh-CN.Label parts by material group, keep a kn: Label parts by material group, keep a known reference edge, and work from the largest stable cuts toward smaller parts. A good diagram helps the operator make safe, traceable cuts; it does not replace handling judgment or tool instructions.
zh-CN.Save the Assumptions for the Next Revisi: Save the Assumptions for the Next Revision
zh-CN.The target is a sheet order and cut list: The target is a sheet order and cut list that protect the longest parts. Save the inputs, dimensions, material choice, kerf, and the reason for the selected option. Those notes make later edits faster and help identify why a new layout differs from the original.
zh-CN.Plywood Cutting Calculator helps turn th: Plywood Cutting Calculator helps turn this search into a reviewable calculation. Use Bookcase Cut List Template as the project-specific reference, then compare the final layout with the actual material and job conditions before cutting.
zh-CN.Define the decision: how many sheets the: 确认所有零件名称和数量。
zh-CN.Record the real inputs: finished width,: 设置真实板材尺寸与锯缝。
zh-CN.Keep material groups, kerf, and visible-: 检查纹理方向和可见面。
zh-CN.Prevent this error: counting shelf area: 保存或导出最终切割方案。
zh-CN.Finish with a sheet order and cut list t: Finish with a sheet order and cut list that protect the longest parts.
